# GrowthOS (grothos.in)

> GrowthOS (grothos.in) is an AI-powered SEO, AEO and GEO (AI visibility / LLM visibility) growth engine for teams in India and worldwide.
> Connect a site, scan issues, approve safe fixes, and deploy with verification and rollback.
